data.method: Exact integer positive state recurrence, independently compared with the derivative polynomial recurrence and direct finite enumeration. No source-paper code was executed.

proved: For every fixed integer d>=0: factorial-normalized root and scaled consecutive ratio equal 6/pi^2 in the limit.
Exponential concentration of the d-ascent fraction at 6/pi^2 for each fixed d.
For d=1: log(a_n/(n!mu^n)) = (1/2)log^2 n + O(log^2 n/log log n).
For d=1: signed Lambert threshold inverse with error O(log x/log log x).
not_proved: Full tilted pressure away from mark one
Uniformity for d growing with n

source_review_scope: Bounded literature check through 2026-10-02; no exhaustive novelty certificate. Primary sources supply definitions and exact input. New analytic arguments are written out in the report.
verification_scope: Finite exact certificates and numerical sanity checks are separate and do not replace the analytic proofs.
